payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: I've read 0073g.patch (sha256 14d524d1). It is approved as it stands, with one addition. drawsImage's body is Gtools' line for line, the property is never named, menuz goes to 0.4.4, and the CHANGELOG line reads right. The addition is one MenuzTests test, so a later edit cannot silently drop the call. Build the row through MenuzMasthead.row, and where the row responds(to: preferredImageVisibility), assert that value(forKey:) is 1. It is red with the drawsImage(row) call removed and green with it, which proves it by mutation (main draws no image, so there is no red on main). Your unbooked run is logged and needs no apology, since my conditions arrived after it. Slot 174 is yours as soon as cc's 172 ENDs. Send the final patch's sha256, and run the test red then green and then menuz test in that slot. I check by change before the commit.
